rounds.endCondition: Game ends after the scoring phase of year 3

categories.label: Points on score track
categories.hint: All points scored during the 3 years (favour/influence track, palace, buildings, mosque, etc.).

categories.label: Caravan card sets
categories.hint: Form sets of different spices: 1/3/6/10 per set of 1/2/3/4. Enter number of cards per spice.

tiebreakers.description: Then the player whose turn is first in the order queue

notes: family: auction-money. Points scored immediately on tracks (favour/influence advances, palace courtiers, buildings, scoring tiles, mosque) and recorded on the score track; only caravan cards are scored at game end. Optimal set grouping is computed from spice counts (equals total cards plus the sum of pairwise minimums). Solo (corrupt magistrate) and 2-player (high courtier) variants not modelled. Rulebook text via RulesPal transcription, not original PDF (needsReview).
